about: Semantic Scholar, an AI-powered search engine for scientific literature. The CLI searches and looks up papers, authors, citations, references and recommendations through the official Semantic Scholar Academic Graph and Recommendations APIs, and also offers the web app's title autocomplete.

commands.summary: Find the single paper that best matches a given title (returns 404 if there is no good match)

params.name: query
params.description: Paper title, or close to it

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated paper fields to return (sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output)

params.name: apiKey
params.description: Optional Semantic Scholar API key; reduces 429 rate limiting

commands.summary: List the papers that cite a given paper (citing papers, with context/intents)

params.name: paper_id
params.description: S2 paper ID or prefixed ID (DOI:, ARXIV:, CorpusId:, ...)

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields of the citing paper plus contexts,intents,isInfluential (sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output)

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page, max 1000 (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: apiKey
params.description: Optional Semantic Scholar API key; reduces 429 rate limiting

commands.summary: Get an author profile: name, affiliations, homepage, paper count, citation count, h-index

params.name: author_id
params.description: S2 author ID (the number in /author/<slug>/<id> URLs)

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated author fields (sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output)

params.name: apiKey
params.description: Optional Semantic Scholar API key; reduces 429 rate limiting

commands.summary: Title and query suggestions for partial text, as shown in the semanticscholar.org search box

params.name: q
params.description: Partial query text, typically the start of a paper title
